decisions.target: Passengers booked on Kestrel flights to or from Orlando or Philadelphia between December 21 and December 27

actions.action: Free changes and cancellations for bookings in a 2-week window

decisions.message: Kestrel Air: a 48-hour ground handling strike is planned at Orlando and Philadelphia on Dec 22-23, and flights on those days may be late or canceled. If you can travel on another day, move your flight now for free in the app: Dec 21 and Dec 24 still have seats. If you keep your flight and it is canceled, we will rebook you on the next Kestrel flight with a free seat, or refund you in full if you prefer. All our aircraft are back in service after the engine inspections.
decisions.why:
Own seats in week 8 are 97% booked, so moving people off the strike days early is the cheapest protection.
The strike-day response follows in week 8, once we know whether the strike is extended.
An honest early warning is what passengers remember.

decisions.target: Passengers booked on Kestrel flights at Orlando or Philadelphia on December 22-23

actions.action: Extra airport and call-center staff for 2 weeks

decisions.message: Kestrel Air: the ground handling strike at Orlando and Philadelphia is on December 22-23, and flights on those days may be late or canceled. We have added airport and call-center staff for the next two weeks, so help at the airport and on the phone is faster. If your flight is canceled or delayed over 3 hours, we will rebook you on the next Kestrel flight with a free seat, or refund you in full.
decisions.why:
Waits of over an hour on the phone turn a canceled flight into a complaint.
Extra staff make rebooking and refunds faster for everyone at both bases.
Being helped quickly is what passengers remember.
